title: A run admits an epic whose acceptance marks parse as fewer items than it marks
description:
The one-item-per-line rule was written into the learnings at ymf's close-out and applied to ymf's own record the same day; ozw was planned one line again the next morning, spent the whole epic with [A2]..[A5] unkeyable, and its round-1 review could not name the item its blocking finding broke. The run's only reader of an epic's criteria is the PR's done-evidence section, after the fact (internal/reconcile/pr_reviewer.go:220); nothing checks the record when the epic is claimed or admitted, so the rule rests on the planner reading a learnings file at the moment of writing the record. The check is cheap — acceptance.Parse against the [A<n>] marks the text carries — and the repair channel already exists (the tracker edit): a run that admits an epic whose marks parse as fewer items than it marks should re-flow it or refuse, not blind its own evidence binding for the epic's whole life and repair the record at close-out.
evidence: .tick/issues/ozw.json acceptance_criteria (one line, [A1]..[A5]) against .tick/issues/ymf.json (re-flowed 2026-10-09, the day before ozw was created); internal/reconcile/pr_reviewer.go:220 (the only acceptance.Parse reader, post hoc)
